generate_graph_from_atomic_structure: generate a graph representation from atomic structure data with cutoff distance and periodic boundary conditions
filter_edges_by_node_partition: filter graph edges to keep only those where the target atom belongs to the current rank node partition
compute_pbc_distances: compute interatomic distances with periodic boundary condition corrections using cell offsets and edge indices
generate_graph_with_nvidia_pbc: generate a graph using the NVIDIA radius graph PBC implementation for accelerated neighbor search
generate_graph_with_node_partitioning: generate a graph with distributed node partitioning to filter edges for multi-rank inference
